howto: You run on your own toward the finish flag, racing a rival builder on the next span.
Snatch the floating planks: each one is material.
At a gap, hold (or Down) to lay planks across it; tap (or Space) hops the orange cones.
Run out of planks at a gap and you fall. Reach the flag first for the big bonus.
tips: Every gap auto-builds slowly; holding builds faster and saves your lead.
Cones knock 1 to 3 planks loose, so hop them even when you are in a hurry.
Keep a few planks spare before each wide gap: later legs have longer gaps and less ground.
Finishing first is worth 500 points, second 200: the rival matters more than distance.

controls.keyboard: Space, W or Up to hop; hold S, Down or J to build; M mutes; P or Esc pauses
controls.touch: Tap to hop; press and hold at a gap to build; the pause button sits bottom right

difficulty: An adaptive curve: speed climbs from 10 to 22 over the first 520 m, gaps widen from 3 to 6 planks, the ground between them shrinks, and cones cost up to 3 planks in the later legs.

cheats.effect: Planks cost nothing: every gap bridges itself
The rival builder works at three-quarter speed
Cones cost no material and never trip you

features.one-tap-start: Tap anywhere on the title (or Space) to start
features.instant-restart: Race again on the results screen, Space, or Restart in the pause menu
features.best-score-badge: Best on the title card and a live Best cell in the HUD (starred when you pass it)
features.tutorial-card: A skippable coach card at the first gap on the first run; Replay tutorial in How to play
features.results: Results screen with placing, score, distance, planks, gaps and all-time best

settings.quality: Graphics: High / Low button on the title card. High: up to 2x pixel ratio and soft shadows; Low: 1x, no shadow pass and half the island scenery.
